==English==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|respounden}}, from {{der|en|fro|respondre}}, from {{der|en|la-lat|respondō}}, from {{der|en|la|respondeō}}. Cf. Modern {{cog|fr|répondre}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈspɒnd/|/ɹəˈspɒnd/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈspɑnd/|/ɹəˈspɑnd/|a=GA}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-respond.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɒnd|s=2}}
* {{homophones|en|respawned}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive|intransitive}} To [[say]] something in [[return]]; to [[answer]]; to [[reply]].
#: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:respond}}
#: {{co|en|to '''respond''' to a question or an argument}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[act]] in return; to [[carry out]] an [[action]] or in return to a [[force]] or [[stimulus]]; to [[do]] something in [[response]].
# {{lb|en|ambitransitive}} To [[correspond]] with; to [[suit]].
#* {{RQ:Tasso Fairfax Godfrey of Bulloigne
|passage=For his great deeds '''respond''' his speeches great.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[satisfy]]; to [[answer]].
#: {{ux|en|The prisoner was held to '''respond''' the judgment of the court.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To be [[liable]] for [[payment]].
